description: This file contains test cases for the functions 'shouldSkipPrepack' and 'collectPreparedPrepackErrors', using the 'vitest' framework. It verifies the behavior of these functions based on different input scenarios.

methods.name: shouldSkipPrepack
methods.description: Determines if the prepack process should be skipped based on environment variables.

methods.name: collectPreparedPrepackErrors
methods.description: Collects errors related to missing or incomplete prepared artifacts for prepacking.

calls: expect(collectPreparedPrepackErrors([], [])).toEqual(["missing required prepared artifact: dist/index.js or dist/index.mjs", "missing required prepared artifact: dist/control-ui/index.html", "missing prepared Control UI asset payload under dist/control-ui/assets/"])
